findings.claim: The original I76EDIT.EXE 00424FB0 SBH region initializer issues 4MiB VirtualAlloc reserve and 64KiB initial commit requests and initializes its own 1024-page descriptor and first 16 page headers. This original-code path completed with only Windows VirtualAlloc return values synthesized.
findings.limitations: Windows VM operations and real CRT bootstrap state substituted; the 4MiB/64KiB requests and allocator metadata initialization are original instructions but physical OS memory lifetime is not verified.

findings.claim: Original CRT 00425310 and 00425590 allocate 128-byte editor payload blocks in 8 sixteen-byte units; original 00425260 and 004252C0 identify and free blocks. 30 unique blocks fill a 4KiB page, and a freed block is reused at its exact address when the page is otherwise full.
findings.limitations: Controlled one-page allocator fixture and Ghidra original code execution; no original Windows heap manager and no malformed metadata tests.

findings.claim: With original CRT region initialization, 31 simultaneous 128-byte payload allocations occupy 30 blocks on page 0 and one at 0x50001100 on page 1. Original free of all 31 restores both per-page free counters to 240 units.
findings.limitations: Synthetic reservation returns 0x50000000; second page already committed by initial 64KiB commit, so later page-commit/decommit branches are not tested.

findings.claim: An original 00409840 editor-object constructor allocated its 120-byte payload via the original SBH region bootstrap and native CRT allocator, created the separate 12-byte linked-list node, then original 00409DC0/00409A60/00422FA0 freed node and payload. Original SBH marker cleared and free capacity restored 232 to 240, with list head zero.
findings.limitations: Original Win32 VirtualAlloc/HeapAlloc/HeapFree and UI display callbacks substituted; results establish normal control flow for synthetic editor object, not actual Windows OS memory integrity.

findings.claim: Native SBH allocator can service the original 120-byte editor object payload, but whether the actual original editor startup enables this path depends on CRT threshold and heap initialization globals not yet reconstructed under original Windows process startup.
findings.limitations: Original CRT globals were set by synthetic harness to enable the SBH. Do not infer production path or allocation-frequency statistics.
